title: Project-slice freshness assertion for CURRENT routers
problem_or_opportunity: CURRENT routers can contain stale embedded project frontiers, and generic RESUME wording can be mistaken for satisfying an explicit Founder approval gate.
proposed_mechanism: Resolve embedded current project claims against the controlling project state; explicit lock/approval transitions require a matching authority event. RESUME/CONTINUE is insufficient. Explicit HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED/REFERENCE slices are exempt.

development_contract.positive_fixture: stale BLOODBOUND slice vs locked controlling state
fail_closed: explicit approval gate without matching authority event

notes: SI-0008 and SI-0014 are occupied by other candidates; SI-0015 is the current candidate identity.
